name: Helpdesk list schemas
summary: Nine SharePoint list schemas for a helpdesk: tickets, comments, an activity log that drives emails, knowledge articles, technicians, categories, priorities, statuses and employee roles.
capabilities: Ticket list with indexed requester, assignee and status
Comment and activity lists keyed by ticket ID (no lookup columns)
Master-data lists with sort order and an active flag
A role list so the app can show Requester, Technician or Administrator
configuration: Environment variable per list (<prefix>_<Entity>List) whose display name is the list name
notes: The other eight schemas sit beside it in schemas/. Rename the prefix and regenerate with specs/_working/make_schemas.py's approach (schema_builder.py). Sample rows use example.com.
